title: Dark Side of Denver Ghost Tours
includes: We bring some paranormal investigative tools that we demonstrate and you can use if you choose.
requirements: All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels

Thank you so much for your booking, we are so excited to take you out on Denver’s best Ghost Tour. **Please meet in front of Union Station 1701 Wynkoop St. Denver, CO 80202 underneath the Flagpole 15 minutes prior to your tour start time.** **If you do park downtown we recommend to park in the garages and lots in the area. With check-in time and the tour time it is usually longer than 2 hours and the meters on the street only last two hours and we don't want anyone getting a ticket.** **Wear comfortable shoes and weather appropriate clothes. We will go out in rain so bring an umbrella if necessary. We will cancel the tour for severe weather.

Every tour is unique and different. We don't always go to the same locations and route indicated. Sometimes events at buildings will limit our access or things going on downtown. We will always try to take you inside a location but it's not always gauranted.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: What makes the Dark Side of Denver Ghost Tour truly unique is its blend of captivating storytelling, meticulous research, and exclusive access to Denver's historic buildings. Unlike typical ghost tours, this experience transcends simple tales of hauntings. It's a deep dive into Denver's history, interwoven with ghastly and ghostly narratives, all presented in an entertaining and informative way. Step inside some of Lodo's most hallowed halls, where you'll not only hear the stories but also feel the history and the haunts come alive around you. It's a truly immersive and unforgettable exploration of the city's darker side.
